slides.label: Verse 1
lines: With Your blood, You paid for every soul
And gave us a name so man can be saved
Lord Jesus, You know all by name
And we’ll make the world know Your name

slides.label: Verse 2
lines: Heaven and earth shall pass away
but Your Word, our anchor for each day
Some have the sun and the stars as gods
Folly’s the wisdom of men

slides.label: Verse 3
lines: Lord Christ, You’re the first begotten
And the creator divine, You are

slides.label: Verse 4
lines: King of heaven, Our Lord on high
The King of the city of lights
the Son of God You are
Beyond duty,
We raise our hands in praise
Too much for words for us, is Your love

slides.label: Verse 6
lines: The whole world gives powerless thrones
The power of the world is no power at all
Humble on earth, the King from above
To You, there’s nothing unknown

slides.label: Verse 7
lines: You do not change nor age with time
You dwell not in past, present, or future
That’s why You gave us a life so divine
A life beyond time
